parts:
Hello, I need to create a shiny app, that I can host on the shiny app servers on a monthly plan. The problem is I am NOT a programmer or developer so I cannot do this myself, but I do have a working excel based dashboard driven example that uses sliders to change the graphs and already has all the correct formulas and calculations figured out. I would like to have a shinyapp created to replicate this functionality I have already developed in excel, but be able to publish it on the web so people can click a link from my website, go straight to the analyzer and use it from there browser.

I have attached the excel file I use now for reference so you can see what type of shinyapp I need. Please note, the attached excel file uses macros to manipulate the graphs with the sliders so you have to enable macro content or it won't work. Also there is a bug where sometimes you have to scroll down the dashboard page, then back up for the sliders on the right side of the page that are used to manipulate the graphs to show up and work properly. Other than that it works really well.

Is there anyone here interested in developing this into a shinyapp? I will pay for this job. Please contact me at shayne....@gmail.com if you are interested. I don't think this is a big job for someone who knows what they are doing, but simply not possible for me.

Cheers
Shayne
